name: EEKA Fashion Holdings Limited
summary: EEKA Fashion Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, promotion, marketing, retail, and wholesale of ladies' wear products in China. It offers dresses, skirts, trousers, shirts, knitwear, vests, jackets, overcoats, scarves, and accessories under the Koradior, La Koradior, ELSEWHERE, FUUNNY FEELLN, CADIDL, NAERSI, NAERSILING, and NEXY.CO brand names. The company is also involved in the trading of ladies' wear and garments; fashion creation and design activities; brand promotion; software design; property leasing services; and operation of e-commerce platforms.
